thread:
Sophia_CS: Heads up — AcuServe (Enterprise) usage down ~40% over last 3 weeks. Renew in ~6w. CFO looped procurement; they've asked for a price/feature comparison vs RivalAI. Champion Jess left last month. Seat activity & API tokens trending down, embeddings calls took the biggest hit. Need triage + quick retention plan. @Liam_CSM @Jordan_SE any objections to coordinated outreach?

Liam_CSM: No objections. Can you drop the dashboard link and top-level metrics? want WoW numbers and any error spikes.

Sophia_CS: Dashboard: https://redwood.app/accounts/acuserve/usage — embeddings down 62% WoW, gen calls down 28%. No 5xx spike; avg latency +30ms last week vs baseline.

Jordan_SE: Can you confirm model variant/rollout history? If they flipped to a quantized variant or a different prompt template that could explain perf. paste small rollout snippet if available.

Sophia_CS: Rollout notes attached in their account timeline: model switched to `redwood/open-1.3q` on 2026-02-12 at 20% traffic, then 50% a week later.

Jordan_SE: That aligns. Possible perf delta from quantization + cache warmup. I'll pull heatmaps/KV hit rates. Also check token distributions — embeddings often plummet when prefix caching breaks.

Olivia_CSM: I'll own outreach and the customer touch. Suggest a 30-min "re-onboarding" workshop for their new PM and offer a 2-week dedicated trial for high-volume routes. @Mike_RevOps can we provide a short usage credit or promo to buy time while we investigate?

Mike_RevOps: We can offer a 30-day usage credit up to $10k or a one-time 10% invoice credit. Need acct id + last invoice to push the credit. Also will loop legal for promo T&Cs.

Natalie_Prod: I'll produce a 1-page perf readout (latency, errors, model versions, token mix) by EOD. Quick note: regressions are commonly from prompt changes, model switches, or a change to batching/quantization flags.

Sophia_CS: Great — plan: (1) outreach + schedule readout with procurement + PM + CTO, (2) offer trial/credit, (3) present perf readout and recommended rollback/tuning. I'll set the readout. Jordan/Natalie please be on call.

Liam_CSM: Draft outreach below — please tweak before I send: 

"Hi Jess / AcuServe team — noticed a decline in activity and heard procurement is evaluating alternatives. Would love 20–30 min to share a usage readout and a few proposals: a 2-week trial extension, a dedicated trial on key routes, and some targeted batching/caching recommendations to lower cost and improve latency. We can also prepare a short cost/latency comparison vs the alternatives. Are you available Tue/Thu next week? — Liam"

Olivia_CSM: +1 to draft. Add: "we'll prepare a tailored cost/latency comparison using your traffic patterns" to steer convo away from pure list-price talk.

Jordan_SE: I'll prep a heatmap and KV cache hit stats. If they're misusing prefix caching that's probably the embeddings drop. Quick check command to run if they want to self-diagnose: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage/heatmap?account=ACUSERVE`

Mike_RevOps: Sent last invoice #INV-6612 to Sophia. Also added a 30-day usage credit option for the exec deck. Legal looped.

Olivia_CSM: I'll send a 3-question async pulse to their new PM to surface decision drivers. TEMPLATE: 1) Which feature impacted you most? 2) Is price or performance primary driver? 3) Who's on the final approval chain? Please suggest edits.

Liam_CSM: LGTM. No blockers from GTM. :thumbsup:

Sophia_CS: Thanks everyone — I'll schedule Tue 10am PT readout and update after the call. Marking this high priority and tagging as renewal-risk.
